guide.question: Can the model start a cue at full presence, with no swell and no silence?
verify: Listen to the first second of each output only. Does the sound start immediately at full level?
Look at the line under each player. If it says 'x s of silence first', the start was not immediate: no such part, or a tiny one, is what we want. A slow fade-in also means it failed.
Two different prompts were used on purpose, so one lucky result cannot decide. Does it work for both?

cases.title: A clear ending at 30 s: ACE-Step 1.5

guide.question: Does the cue end with a real final chord, close to 30 seconds?
verify: Listen to the last 5 seconds. Is there one clear final chord that rings out and dies away?

Two different random starts were made. Does it work for both, or only sometimes? Only 'both' makes endings reliable enough to time backwards from.

guide.question: Can the model rewrite the join between two cues so they play as one piece?
verify: Play the source: it is the scene 5 cue followed directly by the scene 6 cue, so there is an abrupt change at 36 s (the 'seam').
Play each output. Is the seam gone? Does it sound like one continuous piece?
